facebook.content:
Beloved, the Lord says, “Be still, and know that I am God” (Ps 46:10). In the rush of today, pause. Let His presence settle your heart, for He is already moving in your circumstance. I declare that His peace will guard your mind and His power will sustain your steps.  

What piece of His promise are you holding onto right now?
